# Jenny sidecar artifact packaging lock (universal: Windows, macOS, Linux).
#
# Regenerate from the repository root with uv 0.11.19 (see docs/BUILDING.md):
#   uv pip compile --universal --python-version 3.11 --generate-hashes --extra packaging --no-emit-package setuptools -o requirements-lock.txt pyproject.toml
# uv reuses the pins AND the hash lists of an existing output file, so refresh
# hashes without upgrading by deleting the file and pinning the current versions
# through a constraints file (-c); to upgrade, delete the file and recompile.
# Then restore this header block above uv's own header. Platform-only wheels
# carry `; sys_platform == ...` markers; every pin lists every wheel/sdist hash,
# so one file serves the Windows, macOS, and Linux release legs. setuptools is
# deliberately not emitted here: the hashed build lock installs it first.
#
# constraints.txt holds `filelock==3.25.0`: filelock >= 3.25.1 deletes the lock file on release
# on Windows, which makes sidecar/ai/tools/workspace_store.py file_lock() fail its identity
# revalidation (CMP-TOOL-0006) when two writers contend. Lift the hold only with that fix.
#
# Install for artifact builds with:
#   python -m pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: -r requirements-build-lock.txt
#   python -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-lock.txt
#   python -m pip install --no-build-isolation --no-deps -e .
#   python -m pip check
# This file was autogenerated by uv via the following command:
#    uv pip compile --universal --python-version 3.11 --generate-hashes --extra packaging --no-emit-package setuptools -c constraints.txt -o requirements-lock.txt pyproject.toml
